title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**About the Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly capable
**Lead Data Engineer**
to lead data migration, data engineering, and data governance initiatives supporting our next-generation
**Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform**
.
  
  
This role is responsible for defining migration strategies, designing scalable data architectures, establishing governance frameworks, and leading teams responsible for migrating and integrating data from legacy platforms into Salesforce and Enterprise Service Management ecosystems.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in data engineering, data migration, cloud platforms, and enterprise data architecture with strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities. You will work closely with Salesforce Leads, Architects, Integration Teams, Business Analysts, and customer stakeholders to enable accurate, secure, and reliable data foundations that support AI-powered service experiences, enterprise automation, and business transformation initiatives.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for professionals who enjoy solving large-scale data challenges while shaping the future of Enterprise Service Management, Agentforce, and Salesforce-driven innovation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Migration Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end data migration initiatives supporting Salesforce and Enterprise Service Management transformation programs.
* Define migration strategies, migration roadmaps, cutover plans, reconciliation frameworks, and migration governance processes.
* Assess legacy source systems and determine migration approaches aligned with business and technical objectives.
* Establish migration success criteria, validation processes, and quality checkpoints.
* Drive data cleansing, standardization, enrichment, and remediation activities to improve overall data quality.
* Act as the primary data migration lead across implementation and transformation programs.

**Data Architecture & Engineering**

* Design scalable, secure, and high-performing data architectures supporting Salesforce and enterprise platforms.
* Define data transformation, mapping, validation, and cleansing strategies.
* Develop reusable migration frameworks, ETL/ELT pipelines, and automation utilities.
* Establish Master Data Management (MDM) principles and enterprise data governance standards.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, regulatory, and organizational governance requirements.
* Drive adoption of data engineering best practices across projects.

**Salesforce & ITSM Data Enablement**

* Lead migration and transformation of:

+ Incident Records
+ Service Requests
+ Change Records
+ Problem Records
+ Knowledge Articles
+ CMDB Data
+ IT Asset Management Data
+ User and Organizational Hierarchies
+ Support Team Structures
+ Service Catalog Data

* Partner closely with Salesforce Architects and Leads to ensure alignment with Salesforce data models and platform design.
* Support data readiness activities for Agentforce, AI-powered workflows, reporting, analytics, and automation initiatives.

**Team Leadership & Governance**

* Lead and mentor Data Engineers and Senior Data Engineers across multiple workstreams.
* Establish data quality KPIs, migration success metrics, and governance frameworks.
* Conduct stakeholder reviews, executive reporting, and risk assessments.
* Drive issue resolution, dependency management, and mitigation planning.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, automation, and engineering excellence.

**Collaboration & Delivery**

* Collaborate with Architects, Integration Developers, Salesforce Developers, Business Analysts, and Quality Analysts.
* Support effort estimation, sprint planning, release planning, and project governance activities.
* Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of data migration and engineering workstreams.
* Participate in solution reviews and enterprise architecture discussions.

**AI & Innovation**

* Support data foundations for Agentforce, Data Cloud, AI-driven automation, and conversational service experiences.
* Contribute to enterprise data strategy and modernization initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging data technologies and recommend innovative approaches to improve scalability, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Drive automation opportunities across migration, validation, and governance processes.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* 7–10 years of overall IT experience.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Migration, or Data Architecture roles.
* Experience leading enterprise-scale data migration initiatives.
* Experience supporting Salesforce implementations and transformation programs.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data models and platform architecture.
* Deep expertise in:

+ Data Engineering
+ Data Migration
+ ETL/ELT Development
+ Data Quality Management
+ Data Governance
+ Data Warehousing
+ Master Data Management (MDM)

* Experience working in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven delivery environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, leadership, and communication skills.

**Technical Expertise**

* SQL
* Python
* ETL/ELT Pipelines
* Data Warehousing
* Data Modeling
* Data Quality Frameworks
* Data Mapping & Transformation
* Azure Data Factory
* Databricks
* Snowflake
* Informatica
* Talend
* SSIS
* Cloud Data Platforms
* Data Reconciliation & Validation Frameworks

**Salesforce Expertise**
**Strong Understanding Of**

* Salesforce Service Cloud
* Salesforce Sales Cloud
* Salesforce Experience Cloud
* Salesforce Data Model
* Salesforce Data Migration Strategies
* Salesforce Reporting & Analytics
* Salesforce ITSM Solutions
* Agentforce
* Data Cloud Fundamentals

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions.
* Experience managing migrations from legacy ITSM platforms.
* Strong knowledge of:

+ CMDB
+ IT Asset Management
+ Service Management Processes
+ Enterprise Data Governance

* Experience working with multi-cloud and enterprise-scale data environments.
* Experience supporting large-scale Digital Transformation initiatives.

**Certifications**

* Salesforce Data Cloud Certification
* Azure Data Engineer Associate
* Databricks Data Engineer Certification
* Snowflake Certification
* Informatica Certification
* Other relevant Data Engineering certifications

**Added Advantage**

* Experience supporting Agentforce and AI-powered service management platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, Data Cloud, and intelligent automation initiatives.
* Experience building enterprise data platforms supporting analytics and machine learning workloads.
* Knowledge of ITIL, Enterprise Service Management, and operational support processes.
* Experience supporting digital transformation and modernization programs.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are seeking professionals who:
  
  

* Think strategically while remaining hands-on technical leaders.
* Enjoy solving complex data migration and data engineering challenges.
* Can mentor teams while driving delivery excellence.
* Have strong business acumen and stakeholder management skills.
* Are passionate about data, Salesforce, AI, and enterprise transformation.
* Thrive in fast-paced environments focused on innovation and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a quality-first mindset.

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead strategic data migration and engineering initiatives supporting a Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies including Data Cloud, Agentforce, Salesforce, AI, Databricks, Snowflake, and enterprise data platforms.
* Influence enterprise data architecture, migration strategy, governance, and engineering best practices.
* Mentor and develop high-performing data engineering teams.
* Collaborate with architects, product teams, business stakeholders, and technology leaders driving large-scale transformation programs.
* Accelerate your career toward Data Architect, Enterprise Data Architect, or Technology Leadership pathways.
* Join a rapidly growing organization where innovation, technical excellence, and customer success are core to our culture.
* Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model across Kochi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad.

**Join Us**
If you are an experienced
**Lead Data Engineer**
who is passionate about enterprise data architecture, data migration, data governance, and technical leadership, we would love to hear from you. Join us in building the future of
**AI-powered Enterprise Service Management and Conversational Agentic Platforms**
, creating the trusted data foundation that drives intelligent automation, exceptional service experiences, and business transformation.

AssetMark is a leading wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial advisors. AssetMark's mission is to enable financial advisors to make a profound difference in the lives of their clients. Over 10,000 advisors partner with AssetMark for our investment offerings, innovative technology, advanced services, and expertise, which they use to delight their clients and grow their businesses. We are an integrated team of technologists, investment professionals, and operations experts working to help our clients stay at the pioneering front of wealth management.

Key Responsibilities

• Data Platform Engineering: Design, build, test, and maintain scalable, reliable, and fault-tolerant ETL/ELT pipelines and reusable platform components across Azure and Snowflake.

• Integrations, Data Feeds & MDS Support: Develop and operate inbound and outbound integrations and data feeds, support MDS tools and dependencies, troubleshoot production issues, and help ensure reliable delivery to downstream consumers.

• Data Reliability & Operations: Monitor pipeline health, freshness, volume, schema changes, and failures; respond to incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and improve performance, resilience, recoverability, and cost efficiency.

• Data Quality, Governance & Security: Implement automated validations, documentation, lineage, cataloging, access controls, encryption, and sensitive-data protections in accordance with financial-industry governance and security standards.

• Engineering Practices: Use Python, SQL, and fit-for-purpose data tools to deliver maintainable solutions; follow Git-based workflows, code reviews, testing, automated deployment, and CI/CD standards using platforms such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.

• Business & Technical Collaboration: Partner with product managers, business users, operations teams, data stewards, analysts, and engineers to understand processes, clarify requirements, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

• Global Delivery & Continuous Improvement: Participate actively in agile ceremonies, retrospectives, documentation, and knowledge sharing across the GCC and U.S. teams, and responsibly use AI-assisted engineering methods to improve development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

• Practical experience designing, building, and supporting ETL/ELT pipelines, data ingestion processes, system integrations, and data feeds

• Working knowledge of Python and SQL for data movement, automation, validation, troubleshooting, and operational support

• Experience with cloud data platforms, especially Microsoft Azure and Snowflake

• Familiarity with modern data engineering, governance, and observability tools, including Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Monte Carlo, Immuta, and Atlan

• Understanding of orchestration, APIs, database connectivity, file-transfer patterns, scheduling, and dependency management

• Familiarity with medallion architecture and core data modeling concepts used to organize and manage data across platform layers

• Understanding of data quality, lineage, cataloging, access control, privacy, and secure handling of sensitive or regulated data

• Experience with version control, collaborative Git workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD practices

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate ambiguous data, integration, platform, or tool issues methodically

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams in a hybrid, globally distributed organization

• Experience in wealth management, asset management, financial technology, or a related financial-services domain is a plus

Qualifications & Experience

• 5-9 years of experience in data engineering, data integration, software engineering, platform engineering, or a related technical role

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

• Experience working with sensitive or regulated financial data and following secure data-handling practices is required

Why Join AssetMark?

• Build global data capabilities from AssetMark's Hyderabad Technology Center, an important part of our India GCC

• Work across a broad data engineering ecosystem that includes the data platform, ingestion, integrations, data feeds, MDS support, quality, governance, and observability

• Work with modern data technologies while learning industry best practices through structured mentorship from experienced engineers

• Develop both technical and business domain expertise in the wealth management industry, with clear advancement pathways as you grow

• Collaborate with colleagues in India and the United States on meaningful technology that supports financial advisors and their clients

• Access comprehensive training resources, workshops, and learning materials designed to accelerate your professional development

• Enjoy comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, and a supportive work environment that values your growth

• Opportunity to build your career in a high-growth company backed by private equity

Full Time

Tachyon Technologies is looking for a hands-on Data Architect to design and lead enterprise data foundations for AI, analytics, automation, GenAI, and reporting use cases, mainly for Microsoft/Azure-based customers.

This role works with customers, business leaders, AI teams, and engineering teams. The Data Architect will assess the current data landscape, define the target-state architecture and roadmap, and set the standards for data lakes, warehouses, lakehouses, and AI-ready data layers. The person will own the architecture decisions and will also work hands-on during design, proofs of concept, and critical build phases.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with customer business and technology stakeholders to understand business processes, AI use cases, analytics needs, and reporting requirements.
* Assess current data sources, platforms, data quality, integration gaps, and AI/analytics readiness, and present findings with recommendations.
* Define the target-state data architecture and a phased data foundation roadmap for AI and analytics programs.
* Design enterprise data platforms on Azure and Microsoft Fabric, including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) layers, and curated data products.
* Define conceptual, logical, and physical data models, including dimensional models, canonical models, and semantic layers for Power BI.
* Set integration patterns for batch, near real-time, CDC, API-based, and event-driven ingestion from ERP, CRM, databases, files, APIs, and operational systems.
* Design data architecture for GenAI use cases, including RAG pipelines, document ingestion, chunking and embedding strategy, vector stores, and grounding data for copilots and AI agents.
* Define standards for data security, access control, privacy, metadata, cataloging, lineage, and governance, using tools such as Microsoft Purview and Unity Catalog.
* Set frameworks for data quality, reconciliation, validation, error handling, observability, and pipeline monitoring.
* Make platform and tool choices (Fabric vs. Databricks vs. Synapse, storage formats, compute sizing) and keep cost, performance, and scalability in balance.
* Build reference architectures, reusable templates, and accelerators, and contribute hands-on to POCs and complex pipeline or model development using SQL, Python, and PySpark.
* Review designs and code from data engineers and guide the engineering team on architecture standards and best practices.
* Lead pre-sales architecture work, including customer discovery, solution design, RFP responses, effort estimation, and proposal content for Data + AI programs.
* Present architecture, implementation approach, risks, and roadmap clearly to customer executives and internal leadership.

**Required Skills**

* 12+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or data architecture, with at least 4 years in an architect role.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise data lakes, data warehouses, or lakehouse platforms end to end.
* Deep expertise in the Microsoft data ecosystem: Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Synapse, Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse), Databricks, Azure SQL, and Power BI.
* Strong data modeling skills, including dimensional modeling (Kimball), Data Vault, and semantic model design.
* Strong SQL plus working hands-on skills in Python and PySpark.
* Experience defining data governance, security, metadata, and lineage frameworks.
* Experience with integration patterns across APIs, databases, files, and enterprise applications.
* Ability to translate business and AI use cases into architecture, data requirements, and delivery roadmaps.
* Experience leading data engineering teams and setting technical direction across projects.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and executive stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on architecture experience with GenAI, RAG, vector databases (Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB vector, pgvector), semantic search, copilots, or agentic AI.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, or other enterprise catalog and governance tools.
* Domain or source-system experience with SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Dynamics 365, or finance, operations, and customer data.
* Knowledge of data privacy and compliance needs (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, CCPA).
* Experience with streaming tools such as Event Hubs, Kafka, or Fabric Real-Time Intelligence.
* Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600), Azure Data Engineer (DP-203), or Databricks Data Engineer Professional.
* Experience with DevOps/DataOps, CI/CD for data pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep).

**Ideal Candidate**

Someone who can sit with customer leadership, understand the business and AI use cases, assess what the data foundation is missing, design the target architecture and roadmap, and then guide the team (and step in hands-on when needed) to build the platform, pipelines, models, and AI-ready datasets.

title: DataOps Engineer IV
description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of technocrats focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Data Analytics Engineer to own and operate our Snowflake data platform. This role supports the data pipelines that feed Snowflake, which in turn power data and reporting presented directly to our customers within our products. The role is primarily focused on
**Snowflake platform administration and data engineering**
— account management, performance/cost optimization, data pipelines (dbt, Fivetran), and the overall health of the platform — with security, access governance, and cloud/DevOps responsibilities as a supporting part of the job.

You'll work closely with platform and product engineering teams and cloud operations to ensure the pipelines and Snowflake environment behind our customer-facing product data are scalable, performant, and reliable.

**What You'll Do**

**Snowflake Platform & Data Engineering (primary focus)**

* Administer and maintain multiple Snowflake accounts, including account-level configuration, org structure, and cross-account governance
* Own Snowflake performance and cost: warehouse sizing, resource monitors, query tuning, and storage optimization
* Manage Snowflake platform changes via infrastructure-as-code where applicable (e.g., Terraform, Snowflake CLI/SQL scripts) and change management processes
* Support and maintain Fivetran connectors for data ingestion from SaaS applications, databases, and APIs
* Support and lightly maintain dbt models (staging, intermediate, mart layers) that feed data into product-facing Snowflake datasets
* Troubleshoot pipeline and transformation issues, including those that intersect with platform-level access or performance, to protect the reliability of data presented to customers
* Integrate Snowflake and pipeline health (job failures, data freshness, query performance) into the team's observability stack for centralized monitoring and alerting
* Contribute to runbooks and postmortems for platform and pipeline incidents

**Security, Access & Cloud/DevOps (supporting focus)**

* Own Snowflake security: role-based access control (RBAC) design, object/data-level permissions, network policies, and data masking
* Manage user access lifecycle — provisioning, de-provisioning, role assignment, and periodic access reviews
* Configure and maintain SSO integration for Snowflake authentication via
  **Microsoft Entra ID**
  , working with the identity/security team as needed
* Apply general cloud SRE/DevOps practices to the data platform — mainly
  **AWS**
  , with some exposure to
  **Azure**
  and
  **OCI**
  — covering IAM, networking/connectivity, monitoring integration, and infrastructure-as-code
* Own access certification and periodic access review cycles for Snowflake, producing evidence for
  **ISO 27001**
  and
  **SOC 2 Type II**
  audits where the underlying product requires it
* Maintain audit logging retention and usage/query history analysis to support security investigations and compliance requirements
* Partner with the compliance/security team on control evidence, remediation tracking, and audit responses specific to the data platform

**What You'll Bring**

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering or data platform administration, with hands-on production experience running 
  **Snowflake**
  (account management, performance tuning, cost management)
* Working knowledge of
  **dbt**
  and
  **Fivetran**
  (or comparable ELT tools) for building and troubleshooting data pipelines
* Strong SQL skills and solid understanding of data warehousing concepts
* Working knowledge of Git-based version control and infrastructure-as-code practices
* Comfort integrating platform/pipeline monitoring into a centralized observability tool
* General cloud SRE/DevOps experience, mainly
  **AWS**
  with some exposure to
  **Azure**
  and
  **OCI**
  , applied to a data platform (IAM, networking, monitoring, automation)
* Practical experience with
  **user access management**
  and SSO configuration for a SaaS/cloud platform (Entra ID/Azure AD experience a plus)
* Familiarity with audit/compliance processes (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2) — access reviews, evidence gathering, control documentation
* Good communication skills — comfortable working with product/platform engineering and security stakeholders

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with
  **Amazon QuickSight**
  or similar BI/visualization tools
* Experience with Terraform or other IaC tools for managing cloud/data platform resources
* Experience with Python or equivalent for automation/scripting
* Experience working in a multi-cloud environment (AWS primary, with Azure and/or OCI)
* SnowPro Core or Administrator certification
* Background or experience with GRC, compliance, or security-conscious SaaS environments

***We are an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status.***

* Experience in Agile delivery methodologies.

* Exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, or other SAP functional domains.

**<< What we look for>>**
We are looking for motivated professionals who are passionate about data, analytics, and digital transformation. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical expertise, a continuous learning mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams to deliver business value through innovative SAP data and analytics solutions. They should be proactive, adaptable, and committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**

title: Senior Healthcare Data Integration Analyst
description:
**Aliases:**
Senior EHR Data Implementation Analyst (Epic/Cerner), Lead, Healthcare Data Exchange and Interoperability, Senior Clinical Data Mapping and Integration Analyst, Healthcare Data Ingestion and Interoperability Engineer, Senior Clinical Informatics Analyst - Data Integration, Healthcare Implementation Consultant - Data.
  
  
**About Truveta**
Truveta is the world's first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.
  
  
Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest in the USA and has employees who live across the country. As we expand our global footprint with a new presence in Hyderabad, India, we're building a world-class team to help us scale this mission, and high-quality, well-integrated health data is at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
*This job requires daily onsite work at our headquarters in Hyderabad, India.*
**Who We Need**
Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.
  
  
**This Opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior Healthcare Data Integration Analyst to lead and support the onboarding of member data into the Truveta platform. This role is central to ensuring high-quality, well-integrated data that meets clinical, research, and operational needs.
  
  
The ideal candidate is passionate about working with complex healthcare datasets, uncovering patterns in disparate source systems, and building scalable processes that make downstream analytics efficient and reliable. You will work closely with external member teams and internal engineering stakeholders to profile, map, validate, and automate data ingestion workflows, bringing hands-on experience with clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, or Allscripts and with healthcare data standards including HL7, FHIR, and CCDA.
  
  
Working from the Truveta India Development Center, you will partner every day with engineering, product, and member teams in the United States, so regular overlap with US Pacific (West Coast) business hours is part of the role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead onboarding of data from member source systems and third-party sources into the Truveta platform.
* Partner with external technical and clinical teams to understand source data structures, workflows, and business context.
* Perform comprehensive data profiling to assess completeness, quality, conformance, and integrity.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mappings aligned to platform data models and standards.
* Define, implement, and validate business and data transformation rules.
* Design and support test automation strategies for onboarding workflows, including validation and regression testing.
* Document onboarding methodologies, transformation logic, data quality findings, and validation processes to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing.
* Provide clear, timely communication to stakeholders, from customer-facing discussions to deep technical design sessions.
* Continuously improve onboarding processes to increase scalability, efficiency, and reliability.

**Experience**

* Subject matter expertise in clinical applications and an understanding of how healthcare data supports clinicians, researchers, and patients.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare industry terminology and concepts.
* Hands-on experience with data profiling tools, data quality analysis, and visualization technologies.
* Deep understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, and data lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex datasets and translate business workflows into technical specifications.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and external partners.
* A track record of producing comprehensive documentation of methodologies, processes, and findings that supports reproducibility and knowledge sharing.
* Self-starter with a strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or graduate degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or related analytical field.
* 6+ years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or healthcare data implementation roles.
* 3+ years of implementation experience with clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, or Allscripts.
* 3+ years of experience analyzing large datasets, with strong proficiency in SQL and Python or R.
* Demonstrated experience with data profiling, source-to-target mapping, and validation testing.
* Experience supporting customer or partner engagement during technical implementations.
* Experience translating clinical workflows into informatics or analytics applications.
* Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange standards (HL7, FHIR, CCDA) and clinical ontologies (ICD, SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm, CPT, NDC).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with both customer-facing and highly technical audiences.
* Ability to collaborate across time zones in a distributed team, with regular overlap with US Pacific (West Coast) hours.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience at a health system or healthcare technology company.
* Experience with modern cloud-native platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, Databricks, or Snowflake.
* Hands-on experience with healthcare integration engines such as Mirth Connect, Rhapsody, or Cloverleaf.
* Experience delivering data implementations for US health system clients from a global delivery or offshore engineering center.

title: Senior Manager, Data & Integrations
description:
**Job Description**
**Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations**
**Summary/Objective**
The Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations is the people leader and delivery owner for isolved's India-based data and integrations personnel. This role is fluent across both sides of the house: on the data side, this person needs to operate at the same architectural depth expected of isolved's Principal Data Architect, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling, data lineage, integrity, and governance, alongside hands-on fluency in Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch; and on the integrations side (system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, with deep API understanding, source and target schema design, master data management, and golden record configuration and management). This person owns hiring, coaching, and performance management for all India personnel on the data and integrations teams, and partners closely with U.S.-based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones so that the India team operates as a fully integrated extension of isolved's global data and integrations organization.
  
  
**Core Job Duties**

* Serve as the primary people leader for all India-based personnel on the data and integrations teams, spanning data platform, data engineering, and integration automation disciplines.
* Conduct 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning to support the growth of the India team.
* Hire, onboard, and build a high-performing, collaborative India-based data and integrations organization.
* Set clear expectations, provide direct feedback, and address performance issues effectively.
* Partner with U.S.-based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones.
* Ensure consistent standards, practices, and quality bar between the India and U.S. data and integrations teams.
* Own delivery of system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, including source and target schema design and mapping between isolved and its ecosystem of ERP, CRM, and partner systems.
* Own master data management and golden record configuration and management practices for the India team's scope of work, applying matching, deduplication, and survivorship standards.
* Maintain deep, working knowledge of APIs, including how to design, secure, and structure them for reliable, scalable, automated execution.
* Oversee data platform and analytics engineering work in India, including administration and support of Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch.
* Own data architecture standards for the India team's scope of work, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views, in partnership with the Principal Data Architect.
* Own data lineage, integrity, and cleanliness standards for India-delivered data work, and ensure the team applies data governance and cataloging practices (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Collibra, or Alation) consistently with global standards.
* Apply data quality and testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt tests) to catch and resolve data issues before they reach downstream consumers.
* Ensure the India team's data pipeline work spans the full lifecycle, from ingestion through transformation, storage, and downstream consumption, including batch and, where appropriate, real-time/streaming patterns.
* Factor data lifecycle, retention, archival, and storage/compute cost optimization into architecture and delivery decisions.
* Maintain expert-level fluency in SQL and strong hands-on fluency in PySpark, sufficient to review, guide, and, when needed, directly contribute to complex data engineering and data architecture work.
* Track and balance capacity and workload across the India team, coordinating handoffs and shared work with U.S. shifts to keep delivery continuous across time zones.
* Represent the India team in global roadmap, planning, and prioritization discussions, bringing India-specific context and constraints into those conversations.
* Serve as an escalation point for production data and integration issues originating from or affecting the India team, coordinating incident response with U.S. counterparts as needed.
* Promote adoption of AI-assisted development and automation tools, and establish metrics to improve engineering productivity and delivery reliability.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with architecture, security, integrations, and analytics stakeholders in both India and the U.S. to ensure platform effectiveness and data integrity.

**Job Complexity**
Works on issues of significant scope and complexity where analysis of situations or data requires evaluation of a variety of factors, including cross-regional business and operational considerations. Establishes objectives and work plans for the India data and integrations organization, and exercises judgment in adapting global standards and priorities to local execution. Erroneous decisions or judgment could result in delays in schedules and may impact the overall success of the function. Develops and administers schedules, staffing plans, and performance requirements for the India team; may have budget responsibilities.
  
  
**Interaction**
Frequently interacts with senior management, functional peer group managers, and cross-regional counterparts in the U.S. and India, normally involving matters between functional areas, regions, or business units. Regularly leads a cooperative effort among India and U.S. team members to align on priorities, execution, and planning across time zones.
  
  
**Supervision**
Manages the coordination of the activities of the India data and integrations organization, with responsibility for results, including costs, methods, and staffing. Understands management practices, particularly around professional development and cross-regional team coordination, and is skilled at handling difficult management situations independently.
  
  
**Experience**
Typically requires a Bachelor's degree and 8-10 years of direct experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or integration engineering, with 4+ years of people management experience, including experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
  
  

* 8-10+ years of professional experience spanning both data engineering/data platform work and systems integration work.
* 4+ years of direct people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
* Proven experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams, ideally coordinating with U.S.-based counterparts across time zones.
* Well-versed in both the data side of the house (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Hightouch) and the integrations side of the house (system-to-system data integrations, ideally with Workato).
* Principal-level depth on the data architecture side: strong understanding of medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views.
* Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on experience with PySpark, sufficient to guide and review complex data engineering and data architecture work.
* Experience with data governance and cataloging tools (e.g., Microsoft Purview) and data quality/testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt tests).
* Experience with Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse platform and Airflow or equivalent tooling for pipeline orchestration.
* Experience with data sharing technologies and patterns (e.g., Snowflake Secure Data Sharing, Databricks Delta Sharing), including the governance and access considerations they require.
* Understanding of data lifecycle management, retention/archival policies, and storage/compute cost optimization.
* Deep understanding of APIs, including designing, securing, and structuring them for reliable, automated execution.
* Strong understanding of source and target schema design and mapping for system-to-system integrations.
* Experience with master data management and golden record configuration and management, including matching, deduplication, and survivorship logic.
* Experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently address complex, cross-regional challenges.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across geographies, time zones, and cultures.
* Demonstrated ability to translate global priorities and standards into local execution plans.
* Preferred Qualifications:

+ Direct hands-on experience with Workato
+ Experience with Parabola.io or comparable low-code automation tools
+ Familiarity with streaming/real-time data technologies (e.g., Kafka, Event Hubs) as a complement to batch pipeline experience
+ Hands-on experience with big data ecosystem services such as Hadoop, Hive, HBase, YARN, and Spark
+ Professional services or customer-facing implementation experience
+ Experience operating in a follow-the-sun or globally distributed delivery model

**Position Details**
**Physical Demands:**
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  
  
**Travel Required:**
Yes, up to 15% travel may be required, including periodic travel to the U.S. for team and stakeholder alignment.
  
  
**Work Authorization:**
Employee must be legally authorized to work in India.
  
  
**FLSA Classification:**
Exempt
  
  
**Location:**
India (Hybrid/Remote)

Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations

Our HCM platform, isolved People Cloud, seamlessly connects and manages the employee journey across talent management, HR & payroll, workforce management and engagement management functions. Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have in This Role
  
  
The Technology Data Office (TDO) is responsible for improving the quality, consistency, and trustworthiness of technology data across DTCC by providing data governance oversight in a systematic and federated manner.
  
  
As a Senior Associate within the Technology Data Office, you will play a critical role in operationalizing DTCC’s Data Governance Policy, Standards, and Procedures across assigned business and functional domains. This role focuses on executing and supporting day‑to‑day data governance and data stewardship activities that strengthen governance, accountability, compliance, and data quality—ensuring enterprise standards are applied consistently.
  
  
This position operates in a fast‑paced environment with shifting priorities and works closely with agile, cross‑functional delivery teams, data stewards, data owners, project managers, and technology partners to reduce data risk and improve Data Office adoption across the enterprise.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**
Data Governance & Stewardship Execution
  
  

* Develop, implement, and maintain data governance standards, guidelines, procedures, job aids, and best practices.
* Actively review and update governance documentation to reflect emerging industry standards and evolving enterprise needs.
* Partner with stakeholders and end users to enforce governance standards or remediate non‑standard data usage.
* Develop and maintain metadata repositories and enterprise data catalogs.
* Provide guidance to projects and delivery teams on data governance principles and requirements.

Data Quality Management & Reporting
  
  

* Assist in the identification, documentation, onboarding, tracking, and management of Data Quality Exceptions.
* Coordinate remediation efforts with data owners and data stewards, including evidence collection and validation.
* Monitor, analyze, and report on data quality metrics, KPIs, and trends.
* Design and maintain Power BI governance dashboards.
* Implement automated data quality metrics and KPIs to support transparent reporting and measurement of governance program progress.

Collaboration, Enablement & Adoption
  
  

* Collaborate with and support data stewards across the enterprise on governance and data quality best practices.
* Conduct education sessions and working sessions with Data Stewards to align on governance standards, reporting, and expectations.
* Drive awareness and adoption of Technology Data Office standards and practices.

Risk, Issue & Delivery Support
  
  

* Assist in risk and issue management related to data governance and data quality.
* Align risk and control processes into day‑to‑day responsibilities, escalating issues as appropriate.
* Work closely with project managers and Scrum Masters to create and update project plans where governance activities are required.
* Partner within agile, cross‑functional delivery teams to ensure data governance requirements are clearly understood and incorporated into solutions.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in data governance, data quality, data stewardship, metadata management, or data management within an enterprise environment.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience supporting data governance and stewardship activities within a business or functional domain.

Talent Needed for Success
  
  

* Strong understanding of data governance concepts, including: - Data Elements (DEs) and Critical Data Elements (CDEs)
* Metadata and data lineage
* Data quality rules, metrics, and exception management
* Ability to analyze datasets to identify data issues, inconsistencies, and risks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in ambiguity.

Tools, Frameworks & Methodologies
  
  

* DAMA‑DMBOK framework (conceptual understanding required; implementation experience a plus)
* Collibra (data catalog, governance workflows)
* Monte Carlo (data quality / observability)
* Power BI (governance dashboards and reporting)
* Experience working in Agile, cross‑functional delivery environments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in regulated or risk‑sensitive environments.
* Background in data stewardship with progression into governance‑focused responsibilities.
* CDMP certification (preferred but not required).

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

* Familiarity with Boomi Agent Studio and related components including Marketplace, Designer, Garden, and Control Tower.
* Open to learning and working with other iPaaS platforms and their emerging AI solutions as needed.
* Familiarity with ERP platforms such as Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain, NetSuite, Dynamics 365 Business Central, and CRM platforms such as Salesforce and Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement is a plus.

description:

* Quality & Performance: Troubleshoot integration issues, optimize API and service performance, and ensure solutions meet production standards for reliability, security, and scalability.

* Expert-level programming skills in C#
* Strong hands-on production experience with .NET 6 / .NET 8+ and ASP.NET Core
* Strong understanding of Microservices, SOA, and Event-Driven Architecture
* Proven experience in building and consuming REST APIs, SOAP services, Webhooks, and gRPC services
* Hands-on experience with messaging technologies such as Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, or Kafka
* Strong knowledge of Entity Framework Core
* Experience working with SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL
* Strong understanding of JSON, XML, CSV/flat files, Protocol Buffers (Protobuf), and data transformation
* Experience implementing OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, API security, and API Gateway policies
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions for CI/CD
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, asynchronous processing, error handling, logging, and monitoring

Skills:- .NET, Microservices, API, Kafka, RabbitMQ, C# and Azure service bus

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Shipping
description:
**Description**
Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. With a scale of millions of packages, each with different attributes and delivery requirements, what results is a highly dense graph of nodes.
  
  
We have built a highly respected BI and Data Engineering team which is focused on solving complex problems in worldwide transportation using workflows, optimization algorithms, and machine learning systems. These are large-scale distributed systems handling millions of packages being shipped through the Amazon logistics network.
  
  
As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will develop datasets, dashboards, reports, and visualizations using BI tools, and provide data-driven recommendations to support strategic planning within Amazon Shipping. Additionally, you will deliver across planned projects that will improve overall cost and profitability for the business.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Data Management and Integration: Collect, process, and manage large datasets from various sources, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and accessibility.
* Data Analysis: Analyze complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that can inform business decisions.
* Reporting and Visualization: Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to present data insights in an understandable and actionable format.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders to understand their data needs, provide data-driven recommendations, and support strategic planning.
* Tool and Technology Utilization: Utilize and stay updated with the latest BI tools and technologies to enhance data analysis and reporting capabilities.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
* Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
* Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
* Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

title: VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring
description:
**About Tide**
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
  
  
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
  
  
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
  
  
**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Role**
Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.
  
  
You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
  
  
**As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring You Will**

* Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
* Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
* Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
* Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
* Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
* Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
* Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
* Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
* Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
* Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**

* Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
* Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development
* Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
* Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
* Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

**What You’ll Get In Return**
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
  
  

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

**TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING**
At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
  
  
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
  
  
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
  
  
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

description:

Job Category

Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
We're looking for a highly accomplished and Senior Technical Consultant with 5+ years of experience to lead the charge on complex AI agentic deployments. This role demands a seasoned technologist and strategic partner who can not only design and develop bespoke solutions leveraging our Agentforce platform and other cutting-edge technologies but also lead technical engagements and mentor junior peers. You'll be the primary driver of transformative AI solutions, operating with deep technical mastery, unparalleled problem-solving prowess, and a relentless focus on delivering tangible value in dynamic, real-world environments, from initial concept to successful deployment and ongoing optimization.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Consultant, you'll be at the forefront of bringing cutting-edge AI solutions to our most strategic clients. This isn't just about coding; it's about deeply understanding our customers' most complex problems, architecting sophisticated solutions, and leading the end-to-end technical delivery of innovative, impactful solutions that leverage our Agentforce platform and beyond. You'll be a hands-on leader, shaping technical strategy and ensuring successful outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive Tangible Outcomes through Hands-On Implementation: Be responsible for the end-to-end technical delivery of complex AI solutions, personally writing critical code, configuring systems, and troubleshooting issues, while also guiding and reviewing the work of junior team members to ensure successful deployment and measurable business impact.
* Build Transformative AI Solutions: Take primary ownership of designing, developing, and personally implementing high-quality, scalable production systems. A significant part of this will involve architecting and deploying complex AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based intelligent agents and automated workflows, all built on top of the Salesforce platform.
* Engineer Bespoke Agentic AI Solutions: Work directly with customers to design and build custom intelligent agents using the Agentforce platform, ensuring they precisely meet unique business requirements and integrate seamlessly with existing customer ecosystems.
* Data Configuration & Integration : Own the entire data lifecycle, from strategic design of data models to hands-on building of efficient processing pipelines and establishing seamless integration strategies. You'll ensure data is always ready, optimized, and secure for our advanced AI applications, often navigating complex enterprise data environments.
* Proactively Remove Technical Blockers: Identify, analyze, and directly resolve the most complex technical challenges during all phases of solution delivery, from intricate data integration to sophisticated model deployment and advanced agent orchestration. You'll be the ultimate go-to expert for unblocking progress.
* Drive Agentforce Innovation: Become a foremost expert in our innovative Agentforce platform, pushing its capabilities to the limit. You'll lead the development of bespoke intelligent agents, automate intricate business processes, and craft intuitive user experiences. Your insights from the field will directly influence future product enhancements and help shape the strategic direction of our platform, often representing the voice of the customer in product discussions.
* Become a Trusted Strategic Partner: Embed yourself deeply with client teams to truly grasp their operational challenges and strategic goals. You'll translate these nuanced needs into clear, actionable technical requirements and solution designs, building strong relationships as their primary technical advisor and leading technical discussions.
* Conduct Deep-Dive Technical Debugging and Root Cause Analysis: Perform detailed analysis, debugging, and root cause identification for complex system interactions, data flows, and AI model behaviors to optimize performance, ensure reliability, and prevent recurrence of issues.
* Lead Rapid Prototyping and Iteration: Quickly develop proofs-of-concept and minimum viable products, often coding alongside client teams to demonstrate capabilities and gather feedback for iterative refinement, setting the pace for rapid delivery.
* Implement and Enforce Best Practices: Directly apply and evangelize engineering best practices for code quality, scalability, security, and maintainability across all deployed solutions, serving as a technical role model.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for high-quality, scalable production solutions in a professional environment
* Strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline
* Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying solutions with Agentforce, including integrating LLMs, applying advanced AI orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering techniques, and experience with agentic frameworks
* Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, integration, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Salesforce Data Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Significant direct experience with the Salesforce platform, including advanced configuration, customization, and complex development
* Demonstrated entrepreneurship, a "get-things-done" attitude, and a focus on fast, impactful delivery, with a proven ability to lead technical initiatives
* Exceptional collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Proven ability to lead technical engagements, mentor junior team members, and oversee technical aspects of projects
* Ability to travel upto 60% of the time, as needed to customer sites

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Extensive experience with Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Agentforce platform
* Experience developing and deploying conversational AI solutions within highly regulated industries
* Expert-level experience with Apex and LWC coding languages in a professional setting
* Prior experience in a customer-facing, hands-on technical lead or architect role
* Advanced Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Platform Developer II, Application Architect, System Architect)
* Deep knowledge across Salesforce CRM (Service, Sales, and Marketing Clouds)
* Extensive experience with Salesforce Flows and Lightning Web Components (LWC), including complex custom development

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

**Job Description**
**Associate Specialist Data Engineering**
**The Opportunity**
Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of a technology-driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics, and insights to drive decisions and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
  
Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
  
This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a
**Data Engineer**
with
**2–4 years of hands-on experience**
in building and supporting data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and analytics-ready datasets. The ideal candidate should have strong fundamentals in
**Python**
,
**PySpark**
,
**SQL**
,
**AWS**
, and
**Databricks**
, with practical exposure to data lakes, lakehouse patterns, data warehousing, data quality, and production support. This role is best suited for a hands-on engineer who can work from defined requirements, contribute to reliable data solutions, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and grow into larger ownership over time.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Build, enhance, and support batch and streaming data pipelines using defined technical designs and backlog requirements.
* Develop and maintain ETL/ELT transformations using Python, PySpark, and SQL across data lake, lakehouse, and warehouse environments.
* Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, senior engineers, tech leads, and product managers to understand requirements and deliver curated, analytics-ready datasets.
* Implement data quality checks, validations, reconciliations, and basic anomaly checks to improve trust and usability of data outputs.
* Run, monitor, and troubleshoot pipelines using orchestration and observability tools such as Databricks Workflows, AWS Step Functions, scheduling, logging, monitoring, and alerting.
* Follow engineering practices including unit testing, integration testing, automated data tests, code reviews, and quality gates within CI/CD.
* Support BI and analytics use cases by applying dimensional modeling concepts such as facts, dimensions, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD).
* Write and tune SQL queries for data profiling, transformations, validations, debugging, and performance improvements.
* Use AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, EMR, and CloudWatch to support data engineering workloads while following security practices such as IAM, encryption, and least privilege.
* Contribute to cloud resource provisioning and environment configuration using Terraform, with guidance from senior engineers.
* Package, deploy, and support workloads using Docker and related runtime configurations, including ECS/Fargate where applicable.
* Use GitHub for version control, branching, pull requests, code reviews, and contribution to CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop scalable data processing logic on Databricks / Apache Spark using PySpark and lakehouse concepts such as Delta Lake, ACID transactions, and schema evolution.
* Use Jupyter/Databricks notebooks for exploration, debugging, and PoCs; convert validated logic into reusable modules, tests, and deployment-ready pipelines.
* Participate in Agile delivery ceremonies, provide task-level estimates, share progress updates, and raise risks or dependencies early.
* Create and maintain technical documentation such as pipeline specifications, data contracts, runbooks, and support notes.

**What Should You Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including building or supporting production data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows.
* Practical experience with AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, EMR, and CloudWatch; understanding of IAM, encryption, and cloud security basics.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, and lakehouse concepts such as Delta Lake.
* Strong SQL skills for joins, window functions, data profiling, transformations, validations, and performance tuning.
* Good working knowledge of Python and PySpark, including Spark fundamentals such as partitioning, shuffle, caching, file formats, debugging, and optimization.
* Understanding of dimensional modeling concepts including facts, dimensions, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD).
* Exposure to GitHub, CI/CD, code reviews, branching, release practices, and engineering quality standards.
* Working knowledge of Docker and Terraform for deployment, runtime configuration, and cloud environment support.
* Ability to work in Agile teams, communicate clearly, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, and take ownership of assigned deliverables.

**Primary Skills**
Python, PySpark, SQL, AWS, Databricks, GitHub, Data Lake, ETL/ELT and CI/CD
  
  
**Secondary Skills**
Dimensional modeling, Docker and Terraform
  
  
**Good to Have**

* Exposure to data quality or testing frameworks such as Collibra, Immuta, and basic awareness of data governance practices including catalog, lineage, and access controls.
* Exposure to orchestration tools such as Airflow or modern table formats such as Delta, Iceberg.
* AWS certification such as Developer or Solutions Architect, or equivalent demonstrated cloud experience.

**Who We Are**
We are known as well-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

Amazon Web Services (AWS), CI/CD, Databricks Platform, Data ETL, Data Lake, GitHub, PySpark, Python (Programming Language), SQL Databases

Are you an experienced Data Engineer who has led the development of world-class software or digital products?
